{{Top|leg}}
'''Fuse pins''' were a type of mechanical fastener used in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref> Fuse pins were used in [[Droid/Legends|droid]] construction,<ref name="NEGWT">''[[The New Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref> and they could be tightened or loosened by tools such as a [[Hydrospanner/Legends|hydrospanner]].<ref name="EGWT" />
